children: ITC Limited (NSE:ITC) reported Q2 profit down 20.1% year over year to ₹4,137.12 crore, while revenue rose 1.8% to ₹18,401 crore and EBITDA fell 17.4% to ₹5,160 crore. The company raised Gold Flake RSFT 69 mm pack prices by ₹10 to ₹135 on November 12.
: ITC Limited reported Q2 profit down 20.1% year over year to ₹4,137.12 crore. Revenue rose 1.8% to ₹18,401 crore, while EBITDA fell 17.4% to ₹5,160 crore and margins narrowed to 28%.
: ITC raised Gold Flake RSFT 69 mm pack prices by ₹10 to ₹135 from ₹125 on November 12, marking the product’s second hike this year.
: ITC expects Savlon and Nimyle sales to more than double from over ₹1,000 crore to above ₹2,000 crore in the medium term. The brands have grown over 20% annually under ITC.
: ITC has expanded Nimyle into kitchen sprays and produce washes, broadening its range and extending availability across southern India, alongside nationwide e-commerce and modern-trade distribution.
: ITC launched Carte Lumina Copier, a premium paper range in 70 GSM and 75 GSM options, initially available in Hyderabad and Vijayawada.
